title: people-ops-self-review-and-manager-prep
content:
Quick personal notes for upcoming performance cycle + manager prep (working draft)

Context:
- Role: Sr. People Operations Manager (joined Redwood 2023). Responsible for benefits, onboarding flows, and ops for people-ops tooling.
- FY26 priorities: stabilize onboarding, launch manager enablement program, revamp internal HRSLAs.

Accomplishments (last 12 months):
- Onboarding revamp: reduced time-to-productivity from ~22 days -> ~14 days for IC hires (pilot w/ eng/devx teams).
  - Key wins: standardized first-30-day checklist, automated Slack welcome flow, buddy pairing.
- Benefits ops: migrated benefits vendor and simplified enrollment UI; decreased enrollment support tickets by ~40% in first month.
- Manager enablement pilot: ran 3 cohorts (20 managers total) for feedback and coaching; average cohort NPS ~7.8/10.
- Cross-functional: partnered with infra to add people-ops telemetry to hiring dashboard (influence on offer-to-accept lag).
- Process docs: authored 15 internal playbooks (live on Confluence).

Areas for improvement / open questions:
- Scale: need a plan for onboarding at 2x hiring velocity (where are the bottlenecks? vendor throughput, ops headcount, manager availability).
- Data: we still lack a single source of truth for onboarding metrics; need to pick a canonical dataset and owner.
- Escalation policy: unclear boundaries between people-ops and manager responsibilities for early performance issues.

Goals for next 6 months (draft):
1) Launch "Onboarding at Scale" playbook + run two more hiring team pilots (eng + sales). Metrics: reduce time-to-productivity by additional 2 days; decrease new hire support tickets by 25%.
2) Manager Enablement v2: transition from cohort coaching to asynchronous curriculum + office hours. Metric: manager satisfaction >= 8/10.
3) Operationalize benefits renewals: implement automation for eligibility checks and reminders; reduce manual touches by 50%.
4) Handoff telemetry: nominate owner for onboarding dashboard and define SLA for metric freshness.

Evidence / metrics to include in self-review:
- Onboarding: before/after stats, ticket counts, sample checklist, quotes from hiring managers
- Benefits: vendor migration post-mortem, ticket volume chart, cost/efficiency notes
- Manager enablement: cohort NPS, sample curriculum, attendance numbers

Promotion / comp narrative (draft):
- Positioning: expanded scope beyond "operations" into strategic program ownership (manager enablement + onboarding scale) that reduces time-to-productivity and headcount ramp costs.
- Impact examples: reduced onboarding time, lower ticket volume, documented playbooks reused by other teams.
- Ask: consideration for Principal People Ops (or senior IC band) + comp adjustment to midpoint+; open to discussion about timing and measurable milestones.

Manager 1:1 prep notes (for 03/05 meeting):
- Quick wins to highlight: onboarding time reduction, benefits vendor migration success
- Ask for support: approve headcount request for 1 ops coordinator (to run onboarding pilots), budget for LMS to scale manager enablement
- Feedback I want: clarity on promotion timeline and concrete deliverables to target; feedback on strategic vs. tactical balance in my work
- Risks to surface: team bandwidth if hiring doubles; one vendor has capacity limits during open enrollment season

To-dos (short list):
- Finalize metrics slide for manager (due 03/04) -> include charts + anecdotes (owner: Sophia)
- Prep promotion packet draft (link to Confluence draft) -> ask Priya for review
- Create hiring brief for ops coordinator (draft job description)
- Sync with Liam on onboarding dashboard ownership (block 30m)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Potential experiment: "onboarding concierge" (2-week floating contractor during ramp windows) to smooth high-volume hiring
- Could reuse parts of manager enablement as part of onboarding manager checklist (short manager playbook)
- Keep examples concrete in promotion packet: list 3 cross-functional projects with measurable outcomes (numbers matter)

Unresolved items / follow-ups:
- Get final numbers for time-to-productivity from data team (JIRA-HR-342 assigned)
- Confirm budget constraints for LMS by end of quarter
- Ask Priya for reference examples of recent promotion packets that succeeded

End of notes. Will iterate after manager 1:1 and Priya review.
